issues.description: generate-stories cannot bootstrap a new dataset because it reads data/stories/manifest.json before generating stories.
Documented demo and story-generation workflow is not reproducible from checkout because the required story topic manifest/data is absent.
CLI loads the gated 2B model before checking command-specific prerequisites such as missing stories or vector artifacts.
Runtime dependencies use only lower bounds, allowing untested future major versions and very large CUDA Torch installs.
requirements.txt is unpinned and duplicates package metadata, so fresh environments are not reproducible.
Generated egg-info and outputs artifacts are present in the repo despite ignore rules, making the checkout stale and misleading.
Config loading performs no schema/range validation for dtype, layer fractions, PCA target, batch size, or steering counts.
Story generation writes partial files directly and only writes the manifest last, so interrupted runs leave inconsistent datasets.
Story loading does not validate missing, empty, or undersized story files before feeding them into activation averaging.
mean_activations can divide by zero for empty or BOS-only tokenized inputs.
emotion_vectors silently produces NaNs when any configured emotion has no stories.
pca_components lacks input validation and crashes or returns meaningless results for empty data or invalid variance targets.
Steering assumes nonempty valid layer lists and sane n_steered_emotions; bad config can cause division by zero or duplicate selections.
External story-generation HTTP calls have no timeout, so a hung endpoint can block the run indefinitely.
Integration coverage depends on a gated model and absent story fixtures, so the end-to-end path is not reliably testable in CI.
